generationInputs.prompt: A vintage snark poster set on a stormy night background features a luminous pink donut with legs and hands, an eggplant, a banana, and glowing white viscous liquid, all rendered in a limited red-toned palette on a cream background with a stylized, engraved illustration aesthetic. The central focus is a luminous pink donut, seemingly weightless, from which two female legs clad in black fishnet stockings and black high-heeled shoes emerge. Two hands also extend from the donut, one holding a syringe with glowing liquid and the other a glass pipe. A stylized, engraved illustration of an eggplant with a glowing syringe and a banana with a glowing syringe are positioned alongside. Glowing white viscous liquid is present, seemingly spilling or floating. The background depicts a night sky with abundant lightning and mist. At the top, a large, bold headline arches across in all caps, reading "YO PAS CL SLM FF". Beneath it, a tagline in a stylized font says "TU VRGN SLM ACT". Mid-century sparkle icons are scattered around the headline, and all fonts are in a retro vintage print ad style, adhering to the limited red-toned and cream color palette.
